jobs.requirement_text: Repair Cartoon Network playback restarting/looping and stale or flapping title metadata without regressing shared channel playback.
acceptance_checks: Playback advances continuously through the observation window without unexpected reset.
Displayed title remains aligned with the currently served asset.
HBO baseline does not gain a new playback, title, schedule, or media defect.
Runtime playback trace contains no duplicate-player-load, remote-poll-triggered-reload, title-authority-flap, or repeated-live-drift-seek defect.
evidence_required: channel repository ownership resolution before scoped write
window.__INFINITY_PLAYBACK_TRACE captured after at least 35 seconds of entered playback

jobs.requirement_text: Ensure Cinemax serves the current generated Cloudflare schedule/catalog rather than stale prior programming.
acceptance_checks: Served asset and title equal the active slot.
Schedule version is current rather than stale.
evidence_required: channel repository ownership resolution before scoped write

jobs.requirement_text: Ensure Showtime serves the current generated Cloudflare schedule/catalog rather than stale prior programming.
acceptance_checks: Served asset and title equal the active slot.

jobs.requirement_text: Use HBO as the current preservation baseline while shared channel repairs are made; diagnose it if evidence shows a regression but do not rewrite it merely because another channel is broken.
acceptance_checks: Playback advances without reset or stall.
No repair is performed unless runtime evidence identifies an HBO defect.
evidence_required: channel repository ownership resolution before scoped write

architecture_note: TNT owns the shared channel network/player/schedule integration. Individual channel slugs are separate live runtimes and may have their own repositories; resolve the channel repository before a scoped write. TV-Database consumes TNT/channels.js and is not the default repair owner.
